concerns.location: tasks.md:Metric note + T004/T005 vs constitution.md:Principle VII
concerns.text: Constitution Principle VII mandates connectivity strength be quantified as the MEAN ABSOLUTE correlation across DMN edges. The tasks' 'Metric note' and T004/T005 make the sign-preserving metric primary and demote absolute to 'descriptive secondary'. A task list cannot silently override a constitutional principle; either amend the constitution via its amendment procedure or restore mean-absolute as the primary metric in T004/T005.

T004 validates connectivity JSON against connectivity.schema.yaml, whose description labels strength_absolute as 'Primary metric – mean absolute correlation across ROI edges', while T004 declares strength_signed primary. The task as written will either contradict the contract it validates against or enshrine a metric the contract marks non-primary. Reconcile the schema description and the task.

FR-004 requires Pearson matrices computed 'using the raw time-series', but T003 inserts confound regression (FR-019) before ROI extraction, so the analyzed signals are no longer raw. The task silently weakens FR-004's stated constraint; either amend FR-004's wording (e.g. 'raw time-series after nuisance regression') or document the deviation explicitly in the task.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T005 vs plan.md:Summary steps 5/8 and research.md:Methodology 4/5
concerns.text: Plan and research docs specify THREE ROI-pair edges and three edge-wise FDR tests; T005 runs six edge-wise tests over six unique edges (four ROIs). The task silently expands the multiple-comparison family relative to the plan's stated control. Reconcile the edge count across plan/research/tasks (spec US-2 also says 'three DMN ROIs' while FR-003 lists four).

Plan states SC-001 retention ≥ 80% is 'asserted in qc.py', but T002 only outputs the retention rate in qc_report.json with no assertion or documented decision. Spec phrases it as an expectation, so either add an explicit check or note in the task that SC-001 is reported-not-asserted — currently the acceptance criterion's verification is silently dropped.

result_schema.schema.yaml has additionalProperties: false and does not include a 'test_type' or 'framing' field, while the older result.schema.yaml requires them. T005 validates only against result_schema.schema.yaml, leaving the dead contract in place; the task should note which contract is authoritative so the other can be retired.
